structure: Opening: the aisle is about to become a mess.
Prediction 1: the toddler pulls the bottom can and the pyramid collapses (mother on her phone).
Prediction 2: the tipping jar and the older woman; prediction 3: rolling oranges and the eggs.
Consequence: extra work for the employee who is mopping, right at closing time (clock, sign).
modelAnswer: I think this grocery aisle is about to turn into a bit of a mess. There's a pyramid of canned goods on sale, and a toddler is tugging at one of the cans at the very bottom. The child's mother is too busy looking at her phone to notice, so I'm pretty sure the whole display will come crashing down any second. Nearby, an older woman is stretching up to a high shelf, and the jar she was reaching for is tipping over, so it'll probably fall and smash unless she manages to catch it. Meanwhile, a man is pushing his cart, but the bag of oranges on top has torn, and oranges are rolling across the floor. The woman beside the cart, carrying a carton of eggs, is about to step on one, so she might slip and drop her eggs. All of this will mean more work for the employee who's mopping the floor. And since the clock shows five to nine and the store closes at nine, the staff will be cleaning up long after closing time.

commonMistakes: Nói 'the cans will fall down to the floor' lặp lại nhiều lần; hãy đổi cách nói: 'come crashing down', 'topple over'.
Sau 'unless' không dùng 'will': 'unless she will catch it' → 'unless she catches/manages to catch it'.
Bỏ qua manh mối thời gian (đồng hồ 8:55, biển 'closes at 9 PM'); đây là chi tiết giúp dự đoán kết cục.
